name: numerical-evidence
label: Numerical evidence over a PARTIAL domain
description: Evidence producer, NOT a prover: the tested range must be strictly smaller than the claim's full domain. Exit 0 = all tested cases pass → claim becomes empirically_supported (support only, never verified). Exit 1 = counterexample inside the tested range → FALSIFIED (a counterexample is exact regardless of coverage).

inputs.name: variables
inputs.description: the PARTIAL range actually tested, e.g. [{"name":"n","min":1,"max":10000}]

inputs.name: predicate
inputs.description: predicate to test on the partial range
